heading: Why I’m Running
text: For over 20 years, I’ve dedicated my life to Broward County’s students – as a teacher, instructional leader, and community advocate. I’m running for the School Board of Broward County because our students, families, and educators deserve experienced, thoughtful leadership that puts people, not politics, at the center of every decision.

heading: Why I’m Running
text: With a background in both military service and public education, I bring a commitment to integrity, accountability, and service to every challenge we face.
